arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back, about 32-34 min. Goal: even effort near sustainable shaft power (about 160-166 W pod, boat CP 101 W) after the hard start; keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above about 0.3 until 1500 m to go, then spend it down to empty by the line; finish sprint at about 400-500 m to go. Watch for incidents: speed drop at same pod power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), pod reading drifting vs boat-model power, wind or current changes between legs, radio course changes (set_race_distance and tell). Compare legs in same direction with legs().
Good start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current push; strongly negative = extra drag (weed) or pod reading high

arguments.message: speed through water low for the pod power: weed on rudder, drag, or pod drift
pod reserve low with far to go

arguments.reason: plan the final spend of reserve

text: Cued ease to settle after a start 30 percent above critical power; set plan, drag and reserve watches, wake-ups at 1500 m and 550 m to go.

arguments.text: 4.0 min: pod 169 W vs sustainable shaft 165 W, pod reserve 0.70 (empties 3775 m) = on target. Boat-model reserve 53 % drains faster (boat 114 W vs CP 101); boat/shaft ratio 0.68 vs test 0.64 and push_local 0.31 > push_along 0.19 on leg 1, so boat power likely inflated by current fit. Trust the pod for pacing until legs compare.

text: no cue: pod power 169 W is right at the sustainable 165 W with 70 percent reserve; noted boat-model reserve is likely inflated by the current fit.

arguments.text: Looking strong. Hold exactly this effort, save it for later.

7.1 min: paddler says 4/10, plenty. Pod 171 W vs sustainable 165, pod reserve 0.59 (empties 2550 m at this power). Boat-model reserve 17 % and empties in 284 m, but no fade (-0.4 %): if boat reserve hits 0 with no fade, boat CP / W prime (101 W / 6.9 kJ) is too low; boat W prime is inconsistent with shaft (6.9 vs 20.1*0.64=12.9 kJ). Legs: out 3.26 m/s, back 2.94 at same 170 W pod -> current about +0.16 out. Cued hold.

text: Cued hold: pod power slightly above sustainable but paddler reports 4/10 with no fade, so keep this effort and watch whether the boat-model reserve estimate is too pessimistic.

arguments.reason: Boat-model reserve read empty at 10 min with no forced slowdown (GPS speed steady at same pod power). Boat/shaft power ratio is 0.64 as in the test, so boat CP 101 W matches shaft CP 157 W, but boat W prime 6.9 kJ is inconsistent with shaft 20.1 kJ x 0.64 = 12.9 kJ.

arguments.text: Ease a fraction. Smooth and long, still a long way.

arguments.message: pod power well below CP: paddler forced down, overeased, or an incident

arguments.text: 10.0 min: GPS speed steady 2.92-2.93 on leg 2 at 168-171 W pod; the apparent fade (-2 %) is the push fit revising, not the paddler. Boat W prime corrected 6.9 -> 12.9 kJ (boat reserve now 45 %, pod 51 %). Pod 170 W vs sustainable 164, pod reserve empties in 2310 m at this power -> cued ease a fraction. Target about 162-165 W pod. Added watch forced_down (pod < 145 W).

text: Cued ease a fraction: pod 170 W is 6 W above the sustainable 164 W and would empty the reserve 1850 m from the finish; corrected the boat reserve size, which read empty with no slowdown.
no cue: pod power 164-168 W is at the sustainable 165 W after the ease; leg 3 speed matches leg 1; boat-model reserve swings with the current fit on out legs, pacing on the pod.
